died.name: John Brown
died.cause: final written words prior to execution by hanging
died.last_words: I, John Brown, am now quite certain that the crimes of this guilty land will never be purged away but with Blood. I had, as I now think, vainly flattered myself that without very much bloodshed it might be done.

died.name: Philip Larkin
died.last_words: I am going to the inevitable.

died.name: Desi Arnaz
died.desc: Cuban-American bandleader, actor and film and television producer
died.cause: over the phone to his former wife, Lucille Ball
died.last_words: I love you too, honey. Good luck with your show.

born.name: Richard Montgomery
born.desc: Irish soldier, major general in the Continental Army
born.cause: killed at the Battle of Quebec (1775)

born.name: Emperor Pedro II of Brazil
born.last_words: May God grant me these last wishes-peace and prosperity for Brazil.

born.name: John Barbirolli
born.cause: to his wife after awakening during the night
born.last_words: Anyway, I can get a good rest in the morning. There's no rehearsal till three.
